extracted.name: Taco Dip
extracted.description: This tasty taco dip features a spicy layer of cream cheese and sour cream, topped with lettuce, cheese, tomato, and bell pepper. Happy dipping!
ingredient_lines: 0.25 head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried, and shredded
instruction_lines: Mix sour cream, cream cheese, and taco seasoning together in a medium bowl until smooth. Spread mixture in a 9- or 10-inch round serving dish.
Top with shredded lettuce, then sprinkle Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, bell pepper, and black olives on top.
